Description deliveries are real RabbitMQ messages encoded by Python to match the Go publisher protocol-v2 wire contract; this source run does not execute the Go publisher. Request replay will independently compare actual Go task envelopes.
Retained Python worker task functions execute from test-consumed deliveries, acknowledged after execution without a background Celery worker process.
Borrowed stack requires external serialization with source recording; default proof uses fresh shared-helper services.
Three publication-failure cases inject an exception at retained Python enqueue boundaries. They characterize source partial effects, not actual broker unavailability or Go request-publisher failures.
